# De Balie source guide

## Entry URLs

- Public program listing: https://debalie.nl/programma/
- Venue and homepage program cards: https://debalie.nl/
- Example exact event page: https://debalie.nl/programma/arnon-grunberg-meets-adania-shibli-05-11-2026/

## Observed navigation and extraction

The public listing may show event cards with exact date and time while its page's main HTML exposes little of the calendar. Search the organizer domain for a distinctive event title, then open the exact canonical dated `/programma/...-DD-MM-YYYY/` page. Use the exact page for event subject and speaker information; use the program listing or homepage card for start time. The homepage also shows the venue address, Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen 10, 1017 RR Amsterdam. Example: the 5 November Grunberg–Shibli page describes a literary conversation; the homepage card gives 20:00. The public page response did not expose ticket price, so the research record keeps it unknown.

## Costs, booking and clock changes

The tickets iframe can return no content to text extraction. Never infer price from a blank iframe or a ticket button. Use +01:00 after 25 October 2026. Ordinary author conversations are audience events; label their social fit modestly and do not call them meetups.

## Stopping rule and inexpensive repeat workflow

Only add a date when an official event detail and a dated official program listing establish the same occurrence. Favor workshop, open editorial meeting or explicitly participatory formats. Keep passive talks only when useful and clearly label them. If price, language, end time or solo-attendance policy is not stated, leave unknown or state that limitation; do not attempt ticket purchase.
